note: An append that carries a valid interner but drops the store's decision set is refused. Standing is read against the newest commit's decisions, so committing without a decision the store already knew demotes every fact resting on it from `decided` to `proposed` — the same silent-demotion class the interner guard closes, on the other carried table. `decisions` defaults to empty on the wire, so an omitted field and a deliberate drop arrive identically and neither may proceed (DL-0056).
